paper_level_summary_zh: 引用论文在背景介绍中将[23]作为DAS系统用于地震检测的示例，属于一般性相关工作列举，未对目标论文的亚毫米级能力、首次性等做出实质性评价或使用。

evidences.evidence_quote: These telecommunication cables have already demonstrated capabilities for seismic detection [23], wildlife monitoring [24], traffic flow estimation [25], etc.
evidences.evidence_context: As of 2025, there are nearly 1.4 million kilometers of submarine cables in service [22]. These telecommunication cables have already demonstrated capabilities for seismic detection [23], wildlife monitoring [24], traffic flow estimation [25], etc.
evidences.reference_entry: F. Walter, D. Gräff, F. Lindner, P. Paitz, M. Köpfli, M. Chmiel, and A. Fichtner, "Distributed Acoustic Sensing of Microseismic Sources and Wave Propagation in Glaciated Terrain," Nature Communications, vol. 11, no. 1, p. 2436, 2020.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文引用[23]作为分布式声学传感用于地震检测的示例，属于一般性相关工作列举，引用内容与目标论文标题及内容不符，目标论文标题为'Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration'，而[23]实际指代另一篇DAS地震检测论文，属于误引或合并引用。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 引用论文在正文中提及'这些电信电缆已展示地震检测能力'并引用[23]，但[23]的实际内容并非目标论文，而是一篇关于DAS用于冰川地震监测的论文。
